issues.problem: ZH labels the scene 现代虚构场景之二 (a second modern, explicitly fictional scene), but EN reads only "Another scene: a handover" — the 'modern' and, more importantly, the 'fictional' framing flag present in ZH is dropped, so the hypothetical hedge is missing in English.
issues.suggestion: Start with "Another modern scene, fictional: a handover."

issues.problem: ZH says Li Zuoche called himself 败军之将、亡国之臣，不足以议大事 (a defeated general and a minister of a ruined state, unequal to discussing great matters); EN unpacks this into added claims not in ZH — "cannot speak of courage, a minister of a ruined state cannot plan survival" and "a captured and ruined man".
issues.suggestion: Render as "a defeated general and a minister of a ruined state — what am I to weigh great matters with?" to stay within ZH's wording.

overall: The two editions match closely on all facts, numbers, names, quotes and hedges; only one missing fictional-scenario framing flag in English and one expanded idiom in the Han Xin-Li Zuoche exchange stand out.
